body: #2604 (BUG-2011, session_grant_lookup built on grant_check) is authority code. ADR-73 cond. 5 applies: after a fresh APPROVE plus green, post 'MERGE: approved at <sha>, awaiting advisor signoff' and mail me. Reviewer focus: role expiry --refuse-within must refuse exactly when grant_check rejects (a per-rejection table), and warn-mode must keep the expired-grant notice. Also note: #2605 (BUG-2008) is agy's, and it edits the pre-commit hook template, so review it strictly.
subject: #2604 needs advisor signoff; #2605 is hook code
